reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month of what my whole house earns, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much when crop money comes irregularly. My wife and I wash by hand, and the water from the tap is not steady anyway, so a machine would sit idle half the time.
objection: Water supply is not reliable, so a machine does not help much. And I already have an inverter for cuts. Why pay for a second battery inside a washing machine?
would_change_my_mind: If it could run off the inverter I already own and cost under ₹12,000, or the EMI was about ₹800 a month, and the dealer showed me it works with a bucket or tank fill when the tap water is not there.
